SEX OFFENDER ARRESTED!

4/10, USBP agents apprehended a convicted sex offender attempting to unlawfully enter the U.S. near Langtry, TX. Biometric checks revealed the man to be Emiliano Bautista Zacarias, a Mexican national previously convicted in Santa Barbara, CA, for lewd and lascivious acts with a child and assault with intent to rape. He is now facing prosecution for felony illegal re-entry (8USC1326).

Our agents unwavering efforts stopped another sexual predator from entering our communities.

CHILD RAPIST ARRESTED!

On April 14, 2025, El Centro Border Patrol Agents, working alongside the ICE/HSI Fugitive Task Force, apprehended Cristian Eduardo Munoz-Rojas, an Ecuadorian national wanted for child rape. This disturbed individual sexually abused his stepdaughter from the tender age of 7 years-old until the age of 15 when he impregnated her. He was arrested in Stamford, CT, and REMOVED.

Sex offenders are not welcomed here. Through strong interagency cooperation, we will find and remove these threats.

tweets.text:
Sharp instincts and skilled K9 teams at U.S. Border Patrol Checkpoints in New Mexico and Texas led to two major drug seizures.

Las Cruces, NM- Agents at the I-25 checkpoint uncovered 42 bundles of fentanyl pills during a K9 inspection. The drugs weighed 63 lbs. with an estimated value of $2.8 MILLION.

El Paso, TX- At the Highway 54 Checkpoint, agents noticed a U.S. citizen displaying suspicious behavior. A following K-9 alert led to the discovery of 7 bundles of cocaine, weighing 16+ lbs. and worth approximately $543K.

Both smugglers now face prosecution for 21USC841- possession of a controlled substance.

tweets.text:
ATTEMPTED MURDERER APPREHENDED-

4/16- An aggravated felon claiming to be a Mexican national named Carlos Manuel Lopez, was apprehended after crossing the Rio Grande in Fort Hancock, TX. Thanks to our biometrics database, we confirmed his true identity to be Jose Deras-Valle, a citizen of El Salvador with a violent criminal record. This MS-13 gang member was convicted in Hialeah, FL, for premeditated attempted murder and discharging a firearm from a vehicle.  He was sentenced to 15 years in prison. He now faces prosecution for felony illegal re-entry (8USC1326).

DIRTY MONEY SEIZED

4/15- USBP agents and Chambers County Sheriff's Office seized over $173K of illicit cash near Hamshire, TX. During a traffic stop, law enforcement noticed money protruding from the bottom of the rear seat. The money was tied to illicit operations and was seized. The driver was arrested and charged with money laundering.

Another MAJOR hit to criminal organizations! Since October, USBP and partners have seized over $16.1 MILLION in illicit proceeds.
